answer: Each identity must lock a slashable bond before its cipher key earns any weight, and that weight grows only as independent peers countersign real work over time. A single honest agent reaches its zenith with one bond and a slow record no nebula of lookalikes can copy. Forging that record for ten thousand fakes means locking ten thousand separate bonds and doing ten thousand real jobs; proven collusion slashes every linked bond, so scale multiplies capital at risk, not influence.
